title: BrainCodes: A Lightweight EEG Foundation Model over Discrete Neural Codes
abstract: arXiv:2610.29320v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly emphasize model scale, potentially limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices and in everyday environments. We argue that transferable EEG features can instead be learned with a compact architecture and introduce BrainCodes, a lightweight foundation model pretrained through self-supervised learning on more than 800 hours of recordings from over 1,000 participants. Our architecture combines a quantization-based neural tokenizer with a spatiotemporal encoder that supports arbitrary electrode configurations. The pretraining objective explicitly encourages representations that capture spatial connectivity through channel positional encoding, and sensitivity to narrowband neural oscillations through an auxiliary training objective. translated_title: BrainCodes：基于离散神经编码的轻量级脑电基础模型
translated_abstract: 近来的脑电图基础模型日益强调模型规模，这可能限制了其在资源受限设备和日常环境中的部署。我们认为可迁移的EEG特征可以通过紧凑的架构来学习，并提出了BrainCodes——一个轻量级基础模型，它通过自监督学习在来自1000多名参与者的800多小时记录数据上进行预训练。我们的架构将基于量化的神经分词器与支持任意电极配置的时空编码器相结合。预训练目标通过通道位置编码明确鼓励表征捕获空间连接性，并通过辅助训练目标实现对窄带神经振荡的敏感性。我们的模型在包括睡眠分期在内的多种神经生理监测任务上达到或超越了现有最先进水平。
tldr: BrainCodes是一个基于离散神经编码的轻量级EEG基础模型，通过量化神经分词器与时空编码器的自监督预训练，以紧凑架构在睡眠分期等多种神经生理监测任务上达到或超越现有最先进水平。
en_tdlr: BrainCodes is a lightweight EEG foundation model over discrete neural codes that combines a quantization-based neural tokenizer with a spatiotemporal encoder, pretrained via self-supervised learning on 800+ hours of recordings, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art performance across diverse neurophysiological monitoring tasks with a compact architecture.
